steps.title: Verify company registration
steps.description: Check the company identity, legal form and current commercial register extract.

steps.title: Review articles of association
steps.description: Identify any relevant company-specific rules on corporate decisions and representation.

steps.title: Identify the competent corporate body
steps.description: Determine who has authority to decide the proposed change.

steps.title: Review supporting evidence
steps.description: Check the decision record and supporting documents appropriate to the change.

steps.title: Check company representation
steps.description: Verify continuing representation arrangements and relevant signing powers.

steps.title: Prepare commercial register application
steps.description: Identify the competent registry and prepare an initial filing checklist.

steps.title: Obtain legal review
steps.description: Have the proposed documents and filing requirements reviewed before submission.

warnings: This workflow is preliminary and does not constitute legal advice.
Check the current legislation and official cantonal registry instructions.
The company's articles of association and the facts of the matter may change the procedure.
No documents are automatically filed or legally approved.

appoint.title: Appointment of a director or manager

steps.title: Review appointment decision
steps.description: Check the decision record and whether the competent corporate body made the appointment.

steps.title: Check acceptance of office
steps.description: Identify whether and how acceptance of the appointment must be documented.

steps.title: Check identity and signature documents
steps.description: Determine identity and certified specimen-signature requirements where applicable.

steps.title: Review associated signing authority
steps.description: Determine whether the appointment also changes the company's registered signing powers.

warnings: Appointment to an operational management position is not necessarily appointment to a registered corporate body.

remove.title: Removal or resignation

steps.title: Determine basis of departure
steps.description: Distinguish resignation, removal and other forms of termination of office.

steps.title: Review departure documents
steps.description: Check relevant resignation evidence or the decision of the competent corporate body.

steps.title: Review cancellation of signing authority
steps.description: Check whether registered signing rights must also be removed or amended.

steps.title: Check remaining management structure
steps.description: Verify continuing corporate organisation and representation following the departure.

warnings: Resignation and removal may require different supporting evidence.
Changes to employment relationships are outside the scope of this workflow.

signature.title: Change of signing authority

steps.title: Verify existing registered authority
steps.description: Review existing registered signatories and their signing arrangements.

steps.title: Review authority for the change
steps.description: Determine the competent corporate body and supporting decision required.

steps.title: Identify proposed signing mode
steps.description: Check the intended individual or collective signing authority, as applicable.

steps.title: Check new signatory documentation
steps.description: Determine whether identification and signature certification are needed.

warnings: A change in signing authority does not necessarily involve an appointment or removal from a corporate body.

SA.label: Société anonyme / Aktiengesellschaft

steps.title: Check board structure
steps.description: Review the board composition and internal responsibilities under the applicable corporate rules.

warnings: Distinguish election of a board member from delegation of operational management.

SARL.label: Société à responsabilité limitée / GmbH

steps.title: Check management arrangements
steps.description: Review the management structure, members' decision-making powers and articles of association.

warnings: The applicable management arrangements may differ from those of a Swiss corporation.
